name: DOLPHIN FLOW
blurb: Play chord progressions from your computer keyboard, and hear every note glide into the next chord.
longDescription: DOLPHIN FLOW turns letter keys into roots and number keys into chord types, then voices each change so the notes move as little as possible. Every voice glides into its new note, so progressions flow into each other, and the notes it plays come out as MIDI you can record and edit.
